examples.title: Command approval
examples.description: A pending command approval with sandbox context, arguments, environment names, and editable arguments.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { ApprovalCard } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<ApprovalCard
  tool={{ name: 'deploy-cloud', risk: 'medium' }}
  sandbox={{
    provider: 'codex',
    name: 'workspace-write',
    workingDir: '/workspace/project',
  }}
  operation={{
    kind: 'command',
    command: 'bun run --filter=@lostgradient/cinder validate',
    filesTouched: ['components/cinder/src/components/approval-card/approval-card.svelte'],
    argsPreview: {
      package: '@lostgradient/cinder',
      dryRun: false,
    },
  }}
  env={['DATABASE_URL', 'OPENAI_API_KEY']}
  snapshotId="snapshot-01JZ8"
  policyVersion="policy-2026-06"
  idempotencyKey="approval-command-01"
  state="pending"
  editableArgs={true}
  onResolve={() => undefined}
/>

examples.title: Expired approval

examples.code:

  policyVersion="policy-2026-06"

  state="pending"
/>

examples.title: Patch approval
examples.description: A high-risk patch approval that previews the proposed diff, touched files, and arguments.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { ApprovalCard } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<ApprovalCard
  tool={{ name: 'apply_patch', risk: 'high' }}
  sandbox={{
    provider: 'codex',
    name: 'workspace-write',
    workingDir: '/workspace/project',
  }}
  operation={{
    kind: 'patch',
    filesTouched: [
      'components/cinder/src/components/run-step-timeline/run-step-timeline.svelte',
      'components/cinder/src/components/run-step-timeline/run-step-timeline.types.ts',
    ],
    argsPreview: {
      strip: 0,
      files: 2,
    },
    diff: `--- a/run-step-timeline.types.ts
+++ b/run-step-timeline.types.ts
+@@
+ export type RunStepStatus =
+   | 'running'
++  | 'waiting_approval'
+   | 'succeeded';`,
  }}
  env={['CINDER_RELEASE_TOKEN']}
  snapshotId="snapshot-patch-01"
  policyVersion="policy-2026-06"
  idempotencyKey="approval-patch-01"
  state="pending"
  onResolve={() => undefined}
/>

examples.title: Approval row
examples.description: The shared approval row: risk glyph and question, the tool and where it came from, the consequence, Input, Add a note, Deny and Approve.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { ApprovalCard } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<ApprovalCard
  layout="row"
  question="Refund order 4471 for $42.00?"
  tool={{ name: 'issue-refund', label: 'Issue refund', risk: 'high', irreversible: true }}
  source="Tool runner"
  requestedAt="2026-11-02T10:38:00.000Z"
  consequence="Sends $42.00 back to the original card"
  operation={{
    kind: 'other',
    argsPreview: { orderId: 4471, amount: '$42.00', reason: 'Arrived damaged' },
  }}
  policyVersion="policy-2026-06"
  idempotencyKey="approval-row-01"
  state="pending"
  onResolve={() => undefined}
/>

examples.title: Approval row with Allow for this chat
examples.description: A tool set to On changes offers a checkbox on its own line before Deny and Approve; a tool set to Always never does.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { ApprovalCard } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<ApprovalCard
  layout="row"
  question="Triage the refund request for order 4398?"
  tool={{ name: 'triage-refunds', label: 'Triage refunds', risk: 'medium' }}
  source="Tool runner"
  requestedAt="2026-11-02T10:44:00.000Z"
  rememberScope="the rest of this chat"
  operation={{
    kind: 'other',
    argsPreview: { orderId: 4398, amount: '$27.25', reason: 'Arrived damaged' },
  }}
  policyVersion="policy-2026-06"
  idempotencyKey="approval-row-02"
  state="pending"
  onResolve={() => undefined}
/>

examples.title: Unavailable approval
examples.description: A held approval nobody can answer now shows a neutral word and the reason, with no decision buttons.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { ApprovalCard } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<ApprovalCard
  layout="row"
  question="Publish notes for 2.4?"
  tool={{ name: 'publish-notes', label: 'Publish notes', risk: 'medium' }}
  source="Release helper"
  requestedAt="2026-11-02T10:30:00.000Z"
  operation={{ kind: 'other', argsPreview: { version: '2.4', changes: 12 } }}
  policyVersion="policy-2026-06"
  idempotencyKey="approval-row-03"
  state="unavailable"
  unavailableReason="Release helper is unavailable, so this can't be answered now. It returns when the Demo plugin is enabled."
/>

examples.code:

<ApprovalCard
  layout="row"
  question="Refund order 4398 for $27.25?"

/>
